title: Zur Verwendung von CFRP für ermüdungsbeanspruchte Zugglieder im Brückenbau
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: This work investigates the fatigue resistance of CFRP looped cables used as tension members in bridge construction. Based on full-scale experiments, a fatigue resistance function is derived and extended by damage-equivalent factors accounting for misalignment at the anchorage and variable stress amplitudes. A standardised procedure for determining component properties, an approach for non-destructive quality control, and a method for determining the natural frequency are proposed.
